Help the tribe of Zao cavemen prepare for their great hunt. You recover the first leader's skull, show him the world from the highest points of 11 cities, dance for the god Krunus, make offerings to Pandor and Fasuon and find beer for the feast. You receive a {item:Tome of Knowledge}, a {item:Tribal Crest} (exchangeable for an addon), experience and the achievement **Talented Dancer**.
Help the cavemen prepare for their hunt.
Lazaran, on the mountain between Farmine and the Zao plains
full of {item:Beer} (buy the pot and a mug of beer in Venore) — mission 6
trade it with {npc:Cael} for an addon of the {wiki:Warmaster Outfits}
An addon of the Warmaster Outfits
At the end of the quest: take the {item:Tribal Crest} that {npc:Lazaran} gives you to {npc:Cael} and say {key:tribal crest}.
Gather the 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Lizard Leather and 5 Minotaur Leather before you start: it saves trips.
In mission 2 the order of the locations is mandatory. If you forget which one is next, check your Quest Log.
Buy the {item:Pot} and the beer in Venore when you pass through there, so you do not have to go back.

{npc:Lazaran} lives in a cave on {wiki:Zao Mountain|Zao Mountain}, the mountain above **Farmine**. Get to Farmine by {wiki:Steamship}: in Kazordoon, talk to {npc:Brodrosch} and say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes} (there is also a steamship from Cormaya, with {npc:Gurbasch}). In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: you rise to the mountain surface. Go down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and, right after you land, go **north** to the vines: use them to climb up to the tribe.
Vines for climbing up to the tribe

To get back to Farmine, go down the vines, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to the base. To leave Farmine, talk to {npc:Thorgrin} at the harbour: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. This route is the same as in {wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest}, so you need to have started it.

Go see {npc:Lazaran}, on the mountain between **Farmine** and the Zao plains. Say {key:hi}, {key:help}, {key:yes}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He asks you to recover the skull of the tribe's first leader, stolen by the orcs' wolf.
Going to the northern orc settlement

Go to the orc settlement in the **north** of the Zao Steppe: from the mountain, leave onto the steppe through the pass through the mountains (the same one as in mission 1 of The New Frontier Quest) and head **north**. In the settlement, go up the north ramp and then go down at the marked spot.
Mountain pass to the Zao Steppe
Spot where you go down in the orc settlement
It is full of {creature:Orc|orcs} of all kinds.
Pass through the sealed door to reach a small cave. **Use** the {item:Bone Pile} to get the {item:Skull of a Caveman}.
The small cave with the Bone Pile

To leave, go back through the sealed door, go up to the spot where you came down and leave the settlement by the north ramp. Then return across the steppe to the mountain pass and climb up to the tribe again by the vines.
Go back to {npc:Lazaran} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.

Lazaran gives you the skull back: you have to take it to the **highest point** of 11 locations and **use it** there. It must be **in the order below**. At each right spot a message appears (below, in each step). The coordinates mark the building/tower: go up to the top.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Lazaran}. You get the {item:Skull of a Caveman} back.

To leave Zao, go back to Farmine (elevator) and take {npc:Thorgrin}'s steamship to Kazordoon ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}). From there travel between cities by boat or magic carpet. For the Femor Hills, the easiest is the magic carpet that lands there ({coord:32535,31837,4}).

Go up to the **top floor** of the 4th tower of the {wiki:Ivory Towers}, where {npc:Spectulus} is, and use the skull. Message: *"You hold the skull up high. You can resist the urge to have it look through a telescope though."*
Go up to the top of the tower **west of the boat** and use the skull. Message: *"You hold up the skull and let it take a peek over the beautiful elven town through the dense leaves."*
Go up to the {wiki:Femor Hills} tower, where {npc:Thanita} is, and use the skull. Message: *"Thanita gives you a really strange look as you hold up the skull, but oh well."*
There are extra conversations with Thanita: try {key:Zao} and {key:skull}.
Go up to the temple where {npc:Kasmir} is (above the depot) and use the skull. Message: *"That was a real easy one. And you are used to getting strange looks now, so whatever!"*
Go up to the top of the **tallest pyramid** and use the skull. Message: *"Wow, it's hot up here. Luckily the skull can't get a sunburn any more, but you can, so you better descend again!"*
Go up to the **west watchtower** and use the skull. Message: *"Considering that higher places around here aren't that easy to reach, you think the view from here is tolerably good."*

Go up to the top of the {wiki:Ivory Circle}, {npc:Malunga}'s magic shop (north of the depot), and use the skull. Message: *"Yep, that's a pretty high spot. If Lazaran ever sees what the skull sees, he'd be pretty satisfied with that nice view."*

Go up to the commercial tower in the {wiki:Streets of Yalahar} where {npc:Vincent} is (north of the depot) and use the skull. Message: *"Well, there are higher spots around here, but none of them is as easily reachable as this one. It just has to suffice."*
Go up to the **watchtower west of the magic carpet** and use the skull. Message: *"Nice! White in white as far as the eye can see. Time to leave before your fingers turn into icicles."*

Go up to the tower at the end of {wiki:Harbour Street} and use the skull. Message: *"That's definitely one of the highest spots in whole Tibia. If that's not simply perfect you don't know what it is."*
Go up to the **west tower** of {npc:Queen Eloise}'s castle and use the skull. Message: *"What a beautiful view. Worthy of a Queen indeed! Time to head back to Lazaran and show him what you got."*
Go back to {npc:Lazaran} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Lazaran}. He sends you to talk to the priestess {npc:Ulala}.
{npc:Ulala} is above Lazaran: go up a ladder and then some stairs. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She asks you to do the {wiki:Krunus} dance at the altar.

Go to the mountain **south** of the camp, to Krunus's altar (it has lots of leaves on the ground). Step on the leaves: different effects appear on the ground. Always move to the square where the {item:Plant Effect} appears (it only appears on one of the squares). Stop when you see *"Krunus should be pleased."* The image shows the order of the steps.
Order of the dance steps (follow the numbers)
{npc:Ulala} wants to please the god Pandor with parts of the enemies: 5 orc teeth, 5 minotaur leathers and 5 lizard leathers.
With 5 {item:Orc Tooth|Orc Teeth}, 5 {item:Minotaur Leather} and 5 {item:Lizard Leather} in your inventory, say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Ulala}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ulala}: you have to pray at Fasuon's great crystal, at the top of the mountain.

Go down to {npc:Lazaran}'s floor. In the **northwest** (top-left) corner there is a staircase: go down and cross the caves. Nothing is stronger than a single {creature:Demon Skeleton}. Pass the quest door and go up to the crystal at the top.
There are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Bat|Bats} and a {creature:Demon Skeleton} along the way.
**Use** the red {item:Large Crystal}. You get *"A ray of sunlight comes down from the heaven and hits the crystal. Wow. That probably means Fasuon is supporting."*
Opening the Tome of Knowledge chest
While you are here: on the floor below, to the **north**, there is a chest. Go to it and open it to receive a {item:Tome of Knowledge}.
The chest with the Tome of Knowledge
Go back the same way through the caves (quest door and staircase in the northwest corner) to {npc:Lazaran}'s floor and go up to {npc:Ulala}. Say {key:mission}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ulala}: she will pray to Uzroth herself and tells you to tell Lazaran that the gods are satisfied.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Lazaran}. He wants a **pot** of "brown water" (beer) for the party after the hunt.
In **Venore**, buy a {item:Pot} and a mug of {item:Beer}. Fill the pot with the beer.
Go back to {npc:Lazaran} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Tribal Crest}.
Trading the Tribal Crest for an addon
Take the {item:Tribal Crest} to {npc:Cael} and say {key:tribal crest} to receive an addon of the {wiki:Warmaster Outfits}.

After the quest, {npc:Lazaran} gives daily tasks. Say {key:hi} and {key:task} and choose one: {key:colour}, {key:mushroom} or {key:hunt}. To hand in, repeat the task word and say {key:yes}. The reward is experience ("ancient knowledge of tribe").

Say {key:colour}: Lazaran tells you which colour is missing. Depending on the colour, you need a {item:Bucket} of {item:Blood}, an {item:Orange Star}, 100 {item:Blueberry|Blueberries}, {item:Goat Grass}, {item:Some Leaves} or others. The Orange Star, Goat Grass and Some Leaves appear daily around the Zao Steppe. Hand in with {key:colour} and {key:yes}.

Say {key:mushroom}. Use the big mushrooms in the two mushroom caves (the small cave right north of Lazaran) to harvest them. Hand in the {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms} with {key:mushroom} and {key:yes}: he keeps up to 10 (50 experience for each) and you keep the other mushrooms.
If you do not harvest 10, you can bring Brown Mushrooms from elsewhere: he keeps 10 and pays for the 10.
Say {key:hunt} and kill {creature:Orc|orcs} of all kinds. Hand in with {key:hunt} and {key:yes}.
